scope: Ordinary Android application and disposable isolated Service localhost TCP capability measurement; not Linux guest runtime networking.

platform.scope_limit: One physical Android 15 device; no claim for other versions or vendor policies.

transport: Binder ParcelFileDescriptor; received aliases refer to manager-created kernel socket descriptions.

observations.manager_baseline: IPv4/IPv6 TCP creation succeeded; connected localhost PING/PONG matched independently at both endpoints.
observations.received_socket_options: F_GETFD/CLOEXEC, F_GETFL/F_SETFL nonblocking, FIONBIO, SO_ERROR/SO_TYPE, SO_KEEPALIVE and TCP_NODELAY set/get succeeded.
observations.fionread: Succeeded on connected/unconnected TCP descriptors; EINVAL(22) on the listener in both isolated and manager processes, not evidence of an isolation permission denial.

cleanup.manager_canonical_lifetime: Retained until isolated Binder death; closed by enclosing Kotlin use scopes on normal return.
cleanup.boundary: Probe Service has no forked runner. Binder death proves only this Service process reclamation and does not replace runner waitpid.

timing.interpretation: Small diagnostic exchanges only; excludes binding/startup and is not a throughput, latency or concurrency benchmark.

not_tested: Fresh native Linux runner and its inherited execution state
SCM_RIGHTS delivery/ancillary parsing and error cleanup
Linux guest socket syscalls or original Node HTTP/net workflows
Project network namespaces or per-project network isolation
design_inference: Results justify testing manager-created sockets with direct isolated data/epoll operations; listen/accept require a manager path on this device. Transport and runtime integration still need separate validation.

prior_invalid_run.cause: Loopback validation rejected the IPv4-mapped IPv6 form returned for the Java baseline socket; isolated cases were not evaluated.
prior_invalid_run.fix: Accept only exact 127.0.0.1, ::1 and ::ffff:127.0.0.1; all other address bytes remain rejected.

evidence.source_hash_scope: Actual network probe source files read after the run and independently matched to stage; this is not an APK reproducibility claim.
